title: Marguerite and the Debt
author: Sable Oyelaran
blurb: Silas Yarrow, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
